name: bandstand
title: Bandstand
description: A brass band theme built around the march card — every date is a buff landscape card clipped to a brass lyre, the town in fat slab capitals over five staff lines, with scarlet ticket boxes and a stamped Sold out — on tunic navy with one gold braid, or band-room white.

tokens.--font-slab: fat slab capitals: the band name, page titles, the town on each march card, section headings, the 2/4 time signature, ticket boxes and the Sold out stamp
tokens.--font-serif: old-style serif for body text; its italic sets venues, supports, dates and intro lines
tokens.--weight-slab: how heavy the slab capitals are
tokens.--text-s: small print: ticket boxes, stamps, tables, the footer
tokens.--text-l: intro lines, section headings and post titles in lists
tokens.--text-card: the town or title on a march card in the shows list, and page titles
tokens.--text-hero: the headline on the home card and on a single show's card
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of small capitals, ticket boxes and the stamp
tokens.--color-bg: page ground: tunic navy, band-room white in the light scheme
tokens.--color-muted: quieter text on the ground: intro lines, post dates, the empty-list line, pagination
tokens.--color-accent: collar scarlet on the ground: link underlines, list markers, the quote rule
tokens.--color-rule: hairlines on the ground: post list, tables, the footer edge
tokens.--color-tunic: the navy band of the header and footer (navy in both schemes)
tokens.--color-tunic-text: text on the header and footer band
tokens.--color-tunic-muted: quieter text on the footer band: the description and contact labels; the menu hover line
tokens.--color-braid: gold braid: the twisted rule under the header, the lyre and clips, the current-menu line, contact link underlines and the focus ring
tokens.--color-braid-shade: the dark twist of the braid and the shaded underside of the clips
tokens.--color-card-edge: the thin edge round each card
tokens.--color-engraving: engraving black on the cards: type, staff lines, barlines, time signature; also the inner focus ring
tokens.--color-card-soft: quieter ink on the cards: the show title under the town, an unknown status
tokens.--color-scarlet: collar scarlet on the cards: ticket boxes, status labels, the Sold out stamp, links on cards
tokens.--color-shadow: the soft shadow under each card
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a text column
tokens.--gutter: space at the left and right page edges
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of cards, images and code
tokens.--staff-gap: distance between the five staff lines at the foot of each card (also sizes the time signature)
tokens.--card-ratio: width to height of the big march card on the home page (it grows taller if the words need it)
